Jazakallah 2371 views Q. Is Receiving Leave Salary Without Work Permissible? 2014 views Q. "In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful" Asalamo Alykum, I once had plans to go abroad for studies. I did an Isthekhara for it. I saw my father crying over some mutual business partners' loss and somebody telling me that my father is already burnt. It was such a painful dream that I woke up with tears in my eyes. I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I quit my plans for study abroad, and I have been trying for him to leave all Soodi investments. But when i think that the dream said "he is already burnt" i feel perhaps it is no use. The sin has amounted so much that Allah na karae, but he will burn in hell for sure. So I get disheartened. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. So I wonder, even if he takes out all his soodi investment, if the remorse is not there, perhaps he will not be forgiven for lack of Tauba. How do you interpret the dream? 2522 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 10155 Country: Pakistan Title: AOA,Sir i am working in a multinational Bank in UAE.Now my question is that i am working in a Loan Dept.And v have islamic and non islamic loans as well but there is hardly and difference i can find in both the loean(Islamic & Conventional)expect the word intrest and Profit.And its mandatory for us to sell both the products equaly.So working for that dept is ok for me as i m very uncomfortable please help me. Question: AOA,Sir i am working in a multinational Bank in UAE.Now my question is that i am working in a Loan Dept.And v have islamic and non islamic loans as well but there is hardly and difference i can find in both the loean(Islamic & Conventional)expect the word intrest and Profit.And its mandatory for us to sell both the products equaly.So working for that dept is ok for me as i m very uncomfortable please help me. Answer ID: 10155 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 111/99 B/1429) In loan department, it is difficult to avoid interest-based transactions; therefore you should look for other lawful work. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
